svg.title: Plan, elevation and section
svg.text: Curved glazed roof against the house, rounded corners, top-hung vents
Roof abutment and opening to the house
Curved glazed roof springing from the eaves
and meeting the house wall at +3.800
Steel frame, bronze finish, rounded corners
Panelled base on a brick plinth
Roof abutment flashed to the wall
Opening from the house on the centre line
Indicative dimensions in mm, levels in m above finished floor; subject to site survey and structural engineering.
